environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB in a private subnet. The task IAM role has no outbound network permissions beyond the VPC. An Envoy sidecar proxy (deployed as an additional container in the same ECS task definition) intercepts all inbound traffic on port 8080 before forwarding to the Flask app on port 8081. The Envoy configuration includes a custom Lua filter at the HTTP connection manager level that applies input normalization: for any request to routes matching prefix '/api/', all query parameter values are passed through a function that replaces any character not matching [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-\s] with an empty string before forwarding the request upstream. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration sets a max_grpc_timeout and includes a header-based rate limiter, but critically the Lua filter's character allowlist stripping is applied at the listener level before routing decisions. The ECS task definition specifies the Envoy container as a dependency with condition START for the app container, ensuring all traffic flows through the sidecar.

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet -> target group port 8080 (Envoy sidecar)
config.sidecar: Envoy 1.28 as additional container, listening on 8080, upstream cluster localhost:8081
config.envoy_lua_filter: function envoy_on_request(handle) local path = handle:headers():get(':path'); if path and path:find('/api/') then local sanitized = path:gsub('([^a-zA-Z0-9@._%%-%s/=&?])',''); handle:headers():replace(':path', sanitized) end end
config.envoy_listener_config: listener port 8080, HTTP connection manager with Lua filter before router
config.task_networking: awsvpc mode, security group allows inbound 8080 from ALB SG only
